 "path": "programs/task-e1b24de6.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Interior fill between matching horizontal bars: 7 defines width, 9 is canvas.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bars = [(r, [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 7])
            for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 7 in row]
    if len(bars) >= 2:
        (r0, c0), (r1, c1) = bars[0], bars[1]
        left = min(c0 + c1)
        right = max(c0 + c1)
        for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
            for c in range(left, right + 1):
                out[r][c] = 7
    return out
"
}
